# ZiniChat

> AI Chatbot & WhatsApp Automation Platform for Businesses Worldwide

ZiniChat is an omnichannel AI business assistant that helps companies automate customer communication via WhatsApp Business API, Meta Messenger, Instagram DM, Facebook Comments, and Website Live Chat — all powered by AI, with zero coding required.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://zinichat.com/): Platform overview, features, and pricing summary
- [Pricing](https://zinichat.com/pricing): Flexible plans from Free to Enterprise (BDT & USD supported)
- [Features](https://zinichat.com/features): Full feature list, integrations, and capabilities
- [FAQ](https://zinichat.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about setup, pricing, and AI features
- [About Us](https://zinichat.com/about): Company mission, story, and vision
- [Contact](https://zinichat.com/contact): Support, sales, and partnership inquiry contact

## Key Capabilities & Specifications
- Supported Messaging Channels: WhatsApp Official API, Meta Messenger, Instagram DM, Facebook Comment Auto-Reply, Website Live Chat Widget
- Supported AI Models: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Google Gemini Pro (BYOK & Platform-key supported)
- Setup Time: Under 5 minutes with zero coding knowledge
- Pricing: Free trial available; monthly and annual plans in USD ($) and BDT (৳)
- Multi-Vertical AI Modes: E-commerce Retail, Property/Real Estate, Hospitality, Software/Tech, Financial Services, Healthcare, Education, Logistics, Manufacturing
